dataSafety.banner.title: Enye idatha ekhuselweyo ayinakufundwa
dataSafety.recovery.title: Idatha ekhuselweyo ayifumaneki
dataSafety.recovery.intro: I-AWA ayikwazanga ukuvula ezinye zeerekhodi zakho ezifihlakeleyo. Zishiyiwe njengoko zinjalo.
dataSafety.recovery.keyLost: Isitshixo sokukhusela sale fowuni asisafumaneki, ngoko iirekhodi ezifihlakeleyo azinakuvulwa. Oku kunokwenzeka emva kokuseta kwakhona okanye utshintsho kukhuseleko lwefowuni.
dataSafety.recovery.authFailed: Ezinye iirekhodi azikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa kwaye zishiyiwe zingachukunyisiwe.
dataSafety.recovery.other: Ezinye iirekhodi azikwazanga ukufundwa ngenxa yesinye isizathu.
dataSafety.recovery.safeNote: Ngeli xesha, i-AWA ayibhali phezu kwezo rekhodi kwaye ayibonisi amaqikelelo akhiwe ngedatha engekhoyo.
dataSafety.recovery.newKeyBody: Iirekhodi ezintsha ziza kukhuselwa ngesitshixo esitsha. Iirekhodi esele zingafundeki zihlala zingafundeki ngaphandle kokuba ubuyisa ibhekhaphu.
dataSafety.recovery.discardBody: Ezi rekhodi azisakwazi ukuvulwa. Ukuzicima akunakuphinda kuguqulwe. Ukubuyisa ibhekhaphu yeyona ndlela kuphela yokuzibuyisa.
dataSafety.recovery.nothing: Yonke into inokufundwa. Akukho nto ifuna ukubuyiswa.
saveFailure.title: Ayikwazanga ukugcinwa
saveFailure.failedBody: Utshintsho lwakho alukwazanga ukugcinwa. Oko ukufakileyo kugciniwe: nceda uzame kwakhona kwimizuzwana.
saveFailure.unavailableBody: Idatha yakho ekhuselweyo ayifundeki okwangoku, ngoko i-AWA ayibhali phezu kwayo kwaye olu tshintsho alugcinwanga. Oko ukufakileyo kugciniwe. Vula iinketho zokubuyisa, uze uzame kwakhona.
portableBackup.entrySubtitle: Ikhuselwe yi-passphrase yakho. Yibuyisele kule fowuni okanye kwenye.
portableBackup.createIntro: Idatha yakho itywinwa nge-passphrase oyaziyo wena kuphela, ukuze ifayile ibuyiselwe kwenye ifowuni.
portableBackup.passphraseHint: Iinhlamvu ezili-10 ubuncinane. Amagama amalunga nawo enza i-passphrase elungileyo.
portableBackup.lossWarning: Ukuba uyilahlekelwa yile passphrase, ibhekhaphu ayinakubuyiswa. Akukho namnye, kuquka i-AWA, onokuyiseta kwakhona.
portableBackup.errorUnreadable: Ezinye iirekhodi azifundeki kule fowuni, ngoko ibhekhaphu epheleleyo ayinakwenziwa. Akukho nto itshintshiweyo.
portableBackup.errorGeneric: Ibhekhaphu ayikwazanga ukwenziwa. Akukho nto itshintshiweyo.
portableBackup.restoreIntro: Khetha ifayile yebhekhaphu oyenzileyo ngaphambili uze ufake i-passphrase yayo.
portableBackup.confirmBody: Idatha yebhekhaphu ithatha indawo yedatha efanayo kule fowuni. Iirekhodi ezingekho kwibhekhaphu zihlala njengoko zinjalo.
portableBackup.errorVersion: Le bhekhaphu yenziwe luguqulelo olutsha lwe-AWA.
portableBackup.errorWrong: I-passphrase ayilunganga, okanye ifayile yonakele. Akukho nto itshintshiweyo.
portableBackup.errorProfileMissing: Le bhekhaphu yeyeprofayile engekho kule fowuni. Buyisa kuqala ibhekhaphu ephambili.
portableBackup.errorStorage: Ukubuyisa akukwazanga ukuphela. Idatha yakho yangaphambili igciniwe.
